mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS formId, f.teacher_id AS teacherId, u.name AS teacherName, u.user_no AS teacherNo, p.college_id AS collegeId, c.name AS collegeName, i.class_id AS classId, sc.name AS className, i.course_id AS courseId, co.name AS courseName, i.textbook_id AS textbookId, t.isbn AS isbn, t.title AS title, i.quantity AS quantity FROM order_form_item i JOIN order_form f ON f.id = i.form_id AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.status = 'reviewed' JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.teacher_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_semester_profile p ON p.user_id = f.teacher_id AND p.semester_id = f.semester_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN college c ON c.id = p.college_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = i.class_id AND sc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = i.course_id AND co.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN textbook t ON t.id = i.textbook_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND f.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND p.college_id = #{collegeId} ORDER BY c.name, u.name, i.class_id
